decisive_items: A lateral flow COVID-19 antigen test and confirmatory RT-PCR were both positive
He denied head injury, substance use, or stressors and had no family history of psychiatric illness
response.rationale: Acute-onset psychosis with positive COVID-19 testing and no prior psychiatric history or alternative systemic findings strongly supports COVID-19-associated psychosis. Mercury exposure is only potential and lacks typical systemic features; schizophrenia is unlikely given acute onset and infection context.

rejected.why: No supporting evidence; acute onset and positive infection argue against primary schizophrenia.
Only potential exposure, no characteristic mercury toxicity signs (e.g., tremor, stomatitis, renal injury) and lab abnormalities are nonspecific.
